tools.name: create_project
tools.description: Scaffold a new Thally documentation project from the GitHub template

projectDir.description: Path where the new Thally project should be created

projectName.description: Display name of the project (defaults to directory name)

install.description: Whether to run npm install after scaffolding

enableAiChat.description: Enable AI chat in docs.json (default true)

i18nLocales.description: Additional documentation locales to include alongside English (e.g. [{code:"fr",label:"Français"}])

tools.name: add_page
tools.description: Add a new MDX page to a Thally project and register it in docs.json navigation

projectDir.description: Path to the Thally project root

content.description: MDX body content (placeholder used if omitted)

tab.description: Tab name to add the page to (defaults to first tab)

group.description: Group name within the tab (defaults to first group)

position.description: Whether to insert at start or end of the group

tools.name: add_tab
tools.description: Add a new top-level tab to a Thally project navigation (content tab or redirect link)

projectDir.description: Path to the Thally project root

tabName.description: Display name for the new tab (e.g. "Guides", "API Reference")

href.description: If set, the tab is a redirect link instead of a content tab (e.g. "/changelog")

position.description: Insert the tab at the start or end of the tab bar

tools.name: list_pages
tools.description: List all pages in a Thally project, organized by tab and group

projectDir.description: Path to the Thally project root

tools.name: update_page
tools.description: Update the frontmatter or body content of an existing MDX page in a Thally project

projectDir.description: Path to the Thally project root

content.description: New MDX body content (replaces existing body)

mergeFrontmatter.description: Additional frontmatter fields to merge in

tools.name: replace_page_text
tools.description: Replace one exact unique span in an existing MDX page; prefer this for small edits so the full page never travels through the model response

projectDir.description: Path to the Thally project root

oldText.description: Exact existing text to replace; it must occur exactly once

newText.description: Complete replacement prose for oldText; never include a Track evidence marker

evidenceReferenceId.description: Exact evidence reference ID supplied by Track. When present, the tool appends its deterministic citation marker.

tools.name: read_api_spec
tools.description: Read a bounded UTF-8 window from an OpenAPI JSON or YAML source configured by this project; follow next-start-byte until complete

projectDir.description: Path to the Thally project root

source.description: Configured OpenAPI source; omit when the project has one

startByte.description: UTF-8 byte continuation from a previous partial result

startLine.description: 1-based source line to start at; do not combine with startByte

maxBytes.description: Maximum source bytes to return (default 49152, maximum 184320)

tools.name: update_api_spec
tools.description: Replace and validate an OpenAPI JSON or YAML source explicitly configured by this Thally project

projectDir.description: Path to the Thally project root

source.description: Configured OpenAPI source; omit when the project has one

content.description: Complete replacement OpenAPI JSON or YAML document

tools.name: migrate_docs
tools.description: Create a fresh canonical Thally template, then migrate a GitHub repository or public docs site into it; the target must be new or empty

sourceUrl.description: GitHub repository URL or public documentation URL to migrate

openapiUrl.description: Explicit public HTTPS OpenAPI specification for website migration

apiKey.description: Anthropic API key for non-Markdown file conversion

maxPages.description: Maximum public URL pages to import (up to 10000)

projectDir.description: Path for the new canonical Thally project; the directory must be absent or empty

tools.name: import_docs
tools.description: Import content into an existing Thally project without scaffolding; use only when an in-place import is explicitly requested

sourceUrl.description: GitHub repository URL or public documentation URL to migrate

openapiUrl.description: Explicit public HTTPS OpenAPI specification for website migration

apiKey.description: Anthropic API key for non-Markdown file conversion

maxPages.description: Maximum public URL pages to import (up to 10000)

projectDir.description: Path to an existing Thally project whose runtime should be preserved

tools.name: search_docs
tools.description: Search documentation pages by keyword — returns ranked list of matching pages

projectDir.description: Path to the Thally project root

tools.name: semantic_search
tools.description: Hybrid (full-text + vector) semantic search against a deployed Thally site — uses the same index as the in-app command palette and /api/search

siteUrl.description: Base URL of the deployed Thally site (e.g. https://docs.example.com)

mode.description: Search mode: hybrid (full-text + vector) or fulltext

tools.name: agent_readiness
tools.description: Fetch the Agent Readiness Score (0-100) for a deployed Thally site — the same report as /api/agent-readiness and `thally check`, with per-signal subscores and fixable offenders

siteUrl.description: Base URL of the deployed Thally site (e.g. https://docs.example.com)

minScore.description: Optional threshold (0-100). If set, the summary flags whether the site passes.

tools.name: read_page
tools.description: Read a bounded UTF-8 body window from a documentation page; follow next-start-byte until complete before replacing a page

projectDir.description: Path to the Thally project root

startByte.description: UTF-8 byte continuation from a previous partial result

startLine.description: 1-based body line to start at; do not combine with startByte

maxBytes.description: Maximum body bytes to return (default 49152, maximum 184320)

tools.name: get_context
tools.description: Get the most relevant documentation context for a topic or question, within a token budget

projectDir.description: Path to the Thally project root

topic.description: Topic or question to find relevant docs for

maxTokens.description: Approximate token budget for returned context (default 4000)

tools.name: lint_project
tools.description: Check a Thally project for issues: broken nav references, orphan files, missing frontmatter

projectDir.description: Path to the Thally project root

fix.description: Auto-fix issues where possible (adds orphan pages to nav)

tools.name: translate_docs
tools.description: Translate Thally documentation pages to a secondary locale using Claude AI

projectDir.description: Path to the Thally project directory

pages.description: Page IDs to translate (omit for all pages)

apiKey.description: Anthropic API key (falls back to ANTHROPIC_API_KEY env var)

model.description: Claude model to use for translation

tools.name: sync_from_repo
tools.description: Thally Track: analyze a merged pull request in a tracked product repo and preview the docs task it would produce (dryRun), or dispatch it to the docs repo so the docs agent drafts a documentation PR

projectDir.description: Path to the Thally project (reads the tracking config from docs.json)

repo.description: Tracked repo to sync as owner/repo (defaults to the single tracked repo when only one is configured)

pr.description: Pull request number to analyze (defaults to the latest PR merged into the tracked base branch)

dryRun.description: When true (default), preview the distilled docs task without dispatching anything

docsRepo.description: owner/repo of the docs repository to dispatch the task to (required when dryRun is false)
